newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA INFLATION AT 43.8 PCT PRELIMINARY JAN1-25.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA INFLATION AT 43.8 PCT PRELIMINARY JAN1-25.

text.p: inflation quickened to 43.8 percent between January 1-25 from
26.9 percent in December, National Statistics Institute (NSI)
"The sharp lev fall was the basic factor fuelling inflation
last month because it boosted energy prices," a NSI official
Calculation was based on price data for the first 25 days
of January and did not reflect the impact of the lev slump in
the last week of the month on inflation, the official said.
The lev traded around 930 per dollar on January 24, down
from 580 at the beginning of the month. It nosedived to around
Final month-on-month and year-on-year figures for January
could be expected later this month.
BULGARIAN CONSUMER PRICES JAN DEC'96 JAN'96
